turns.t: Morning, doctor! Well, I did it, I've cut my sleeping tablets down, and I want you to tell me I'm brilliant.
I'd be delighted to, once I hear the details. What are you taking now?
Zopiclone, 7.5 mg at night, which is half of what I was taking in the summer. Took me ten weeks.
That's a real achievement. How have the nights been?
Up and down. Some nights I'm out like a light, others I'm staring at the ceiling thinking about the bins.
And if you don't take the tablet at all?
Then I can't sleep. I can't sleep a wink. I tried on Sunday, and I was up until four, wired.
Any shakes, sweats, or feeling very anxious when you cut down?
A bit jittery, but no, nothing dreadful. My mood's been steady, actually. No low spells.
Good. And remind me of your background, apart from the sleep.
Depression, years ago, which is much better now, and anxiety, which comes and goes.
How much coffee do you drink?
Three a day, the last around four. I know, I know, you've said.
Let me check your pulse and blood pressure. ~
Go on. ~
Pulse 70, blood pressure 124 over 78.
All fine? ~
All fine. Hold your hands out in front of you for me. ~
Like this? Am I auditioning? ~
They're steady, no tremor. And you look calm and relaxed to me today.
I'll take that. ~
What I'm seeing is a dependence on zopiclone that's easing, but not yet resolved, because you can't sleep without it.
Dependence, ooh, that sounds dramatic. ~
It's just the word for when the body expects the tablet. It's common, and you're dealing with it well. ~
What should I do next? ~
Halve the dose again, so 3.75 mg at night, for two weeks. Slowly does it.
And if I can't sleep? ~
Get up after twenty minutes, go to another room, read something dull, and come back when you're sleepy. Don't watch the clock.
Dull I can do. I've got a manual for the boiler. ~
Perfect. And no coffee after noon. ~
Noon! Right. ~
I'd like to see you again in four weeks.
Four weeks. Thank you, doctor. ~

chief_complaint.value: I've cut my sleeping tablets down

clinical_actions.description: Halve the zopiclone dose to 3.75 mg at night for two weeks
If awake after twenty minutes, get up and read; avoid clock watching; no coffee after noon
